Overview

Nonthaburi is a city in Nonthaburi with a population of 1,200,000. A densely populated suburb of Bangkok offering more affordable housing while maintaining easy access to the capital’s jobs, entertainment, and international amenities. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 255 sunny days a year.
